title: Stabilise Redis retries
capability_summary: Flaky Redis-backed tests stop failing once the client keeps retrying a dropped connection instead of giving up after a fixed count.

use_when: A test suite talks to a Redis client that drops its connection under load
do_not_use_when: The Redis URL or credentials are wrong rather than the connection dropping

preconditions: The project's tests run against a Redis client

procedure.action: Run the project's test entry point and read the retry error it prints.
Lift the client's per-request retry cap and run the same tests again.

failure_repairs.signal: tests fail with a retry error
failure_repairs.cause: the client stops retrying a dropped connection
